source.title: O*NET 31.0 Database
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration

selection_rules: Represent each required hotel function with the most direct O*NET-SOC occupation whose definition covers that work.
Use a neutral singular experimental label and retain all source codes; do not imply that the label is a population estimate or exhaustive job family.
For sales and revenue, combine sales management and market/pricing analysis because O*NET has no hotel-revenue-manager occupation; mark the composite explicitly.
Food and beverage uses both department management and direct first-line supervision to cover managerial and operational phrasing.
Do not add or remove roles in response to model scores.

source_titles: Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
roles.include: reception, reservations, registration, accounts and guest information
guest-room and common-area cleaning and linen replenishment

source_titles: First-Line Supervisors of Food Preparation and Serving Workers
roles.include: hotel food and beverage preparation, service and coordination
roles.exclude: lodging functions unrelated to food or beverage

roles.include: building, HVAC, plumbing, electrical and mechanical upkeep
roles.exclude: new construction and single-trade specialist work

source_titles: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
roles.include: distribution, pricing, demand analysis, competitor analysis and sales planning
roles.exclude: general accounting and unrelated advertising production

roles.include: premises monitoring, access, incident and emergency response
roles.exclude: law-enforcement powers and cybersecurity specialist work

roles.include: coordination of lodging and accommodation operations
roles.exclude: ownership status and non-lodging corporate management

alternative_taxonomies.purpose: Test dependence on the two composite functional families without consulting scores.
Restrict to O*NET definitions that explicitly name hotels, lodging, or accommodations.
alternative_taxonomies.warning: Reduced functional coverage is intentional and must not be pooled with the primary seven-role summary.
